evidence_fix.temporal_correction: recorded_at (fabricated, predated its own subject commits) replaced by three git-authoritative author-date timestamps; a first correction attempt introduced a new timezone-splice bug in merge_commit_authored_at, caught by independent verification round 1 and fixed before round 2.

accounting_fix.old_behavior: runtime::census::extraction::merge_batch_into_coverage performed coverage.insert(dimension.as_str(), obligation.status) for every obligation in every recorded batch, unconditionally overwriting whatever an earlier batch had written for the same dimension key. Two independent extractors disagreeing on one dimension (e.g. Extractor A: SYMBOL -> OBSERVED, Extractor B: SYMBOL -> UNKNOWN) collapsed to whichever ran last -- a traversal-order-dependent semantic result forbidden by SEMANTIC-EXTRACTION.md#multi-engine-extraction.
accounting_fix.new_behavior: runtime::census::CensusExtractionAccounting::record_batch appends every ObligationResult as an ExtractorObligationRecord {artifact, extractor, obligation}; nothing is ever removed or overwritten. records_for(dimension) returns every preserved record for that dimension across every extractor/artifact. sorted() gives a deterministic publication order (SemanticDimension -> ExtractorIdentity -> ArtifactId -> stable record identity) that is representation only, never a truth ranking. No automatic reconciliation, no synthesized CONFLICT status, no 'X beats Y' rule of any kind was introduced.
accounting_fix.bootstrap_coverage_map_status: CensusReport.coverage (core/src/schema/mod.rs) is now explicitly documented as a noncanonical bootstrap/derived projection, never populated by CensusExtractionAccounting; build_census's own internal 12-dimension coverage map (fixed in R4.2) is untouched by this wave.
